name: Uttarakhand
tagline: Where the Himalayas meet the heavens

topAttractions.name: Valley of Flowers National Park
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to over 500 species of flowers, including the rare Brahmakamal.

topAttractions.name: Nanda Devi National Park
topAttractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and home to the highest peak in India, Nanda Devi, which stands at 7,816 meters.

topAttractions.name: Haridwar
topAttractions.description: A sacred city and one of the seven holiest places in Hinduism, known for its Ghats and the Kumbh Mela festival.

bestTimeToVisit: The best time to visit Uttarakhand is from March to May and September to November, when the weather is mild and the scenery is at its best.
culturalFact: Uttarakhand is home to the traditional Garhwali and Kumaoni folk music and dance, including the famous 'Chhopati' dance, which is a traditional folk dance of the region.

hiddenGem.name: Ranikhet
hiddenGem.description: A scenic hill station in the Almora district, known for its picturesque views of the Himalayas and its historic British-era architecture.

relatedFestival: The Kumbh Mela festival, which is held every 12 years in Haridwar, is one of the largest and most sacred festivals in Hinduism.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps from the Kumbh Mela festival or have a wishlist item to visit the Valley of Flowers National Park, then Uttarakhand is a must-visit destination for you!
